strings.Щойно встановлена Windows — за один прох: A freshly installed Windows in one pass: drivers, debloat, settings, apps, updates and a check-up. Tick the steps, pick apps and press “Start setup”. The profile is saved automatically; you can write it to a file and repeat it on another PC, and the reinstall USB stick runs it after the first sign-in.
strings.Драйвери з інтернету (каталог Microsoft: Drivers from the internet (Microsoft catalog and Windows Update)
strings.Деблоат Windows: нав'язані застосунки, р: Windows debloat: forced apps, ads, Copilot, telemetry (recommended)
strings.Сканування й автоматичне виправлення зна: Scan and fix what is found automatically
strings.Перезавантажити ПК наприкінці, якщо потр: Restart the PC at the end if needed
strings.Окремі програми — ID з каталогу через ко: Individual apps — catalog IDs separated by commas (for example Google.Chrome, 7zip.7zip).
strings.Додати вибрані на вкладці «Програми»: Add the ones selected on the “Apps” tab
strings.Прибирання Windows від нав\u0027язаних з: Clean Windows of pushed apps, ads, Copilot and tracking. A restore point is created before changes; every change can be undone on the Change history tab.
strings.Натисніть на категорію, щоб побачити, що: Click a category to see what affected its score
strings.Пошук: назва, виробник, версія, INF або: Search: name, manufacturer, version, INF or hardware ID
strings.Натисніть «Перевірити драйвери», щоб поб: Click “Check drivers” to see every device with its driver version and date. Hover over a row for the hardware ID, INF file and manufacturer.
strings.Ємність, історія зносу й час роботи від: Capacity, wear history and runtime on battery.
strings.Перевірка займає від 10 секунд до 3 хвил: A scan takes from 10 seconds to 3 minutes. “Scan and fix everything” also runs the safe steps right away: a restore point, fixes, cleanup, updates and drivers. Each finding can also be fixed on its own with the button in its row.
strings.Перевірити ПК і виконати все, що Debora: Check the PC and do everything Debora fixes by itself: restore point, fixes, cleanup, updates, drivers
strings.Натисніть «Лише сканувати», щоб побачити: Click “Scan only” to see the state of your PC without changing anything, or “Scan and fix everything”.
The checklist appears after a scan.
strings.Встановить і запустить фірмову утиліту в: Installs and runs the PC manufacturer's own tool: drivers and BIOS for your exact model
strings.Debora шукає драйвери для пристроїв без: Debora looks for drivers for devices that have none, and newer versions for the rest, in the official Microsoft Update Catalog (drivers from Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, Realtek and others) and in Windows Update recommendations. Downloads are checksum-verified, and the previous drivers are kept so you can roll back.
strings.Пристрої без драйвера або з помилкою: Devices without a driver or with errors
strings.Завантажте драйвери з сайту виробника в: Download drivers from the manufacturer's website into a folder (.zip archives are fine too). Debora finds the ones that match this PC, skips those that are up to date and installs the rest in the right order, keeping the previous drivers for rollback.
strings.Пошук: назва програми або для чого вона: Search by app name or what it's for (for example “pdf”, “video”, “vpn”)
strings.Позначте програми — клацніть по картці —: Select apps by clicking their cards, then click “Install”. Installation uses winget: official installers, no ads and no bundled extras.
strings.Встановити winget («Інсталятор застосунк: Install winget (App Installer) from the Microsoft Store
strings.Позначте програми, які більше не потрібн: Select the programs you no longer need. Most are removed silently; for the rest the regular uninstaller opens.
strings.Зняти галочки з програм, яким не потрібн: Untick apps that don't need to start with Windows (game launchers, “helpers”, manufacturer promos) and apply
strings.Зніміть галочку з програм, яким не потрі: Untick apps that don't need to start with Windows and click “Apply changes”. Nothing is uninstalled — the apps just stop starting by themselves, and everything can be undone.
strings.Температура, знос SSD, години роботи й п: Temperature, SSD wear, power-on hours and errors (SMART) for every drive.
strings.Знімок системи, до якого можна повернути: A system snapshot you can go back to if something goes wrong after changes.
strings.Тимчасові файли, кеш оновлень Windows, д: Temporary files, Windows Update cache, crash dumps and error reports, leftover driver installers. The Recycle Bin is not touched.
strings.DISM і SFC — коли Windows поводиться див: DISM and SFC — when Windows behaves oddly, updates fail or built-in apps won't open. Takes 10–40 minutes and needs the internet.
strings.Коли бувають сині екрани з різними кодам: When you get blue screens with different codes or many apps crash. The test runs during the next restart (10–20 minutes); the next scan shows the result.
strings.Коли пошук у «Пуску» не знаходить файли: When Start search can't find files or apps, or the index takes gigabytes. The index is rebuilt in the background over a few hours.
strings.Коли замість значків білі аркуші, значки: When icons show as blank pages, are mixed up, or photo thumbnails are out of date. File Explorer restarts (open folder windows will close).
strings.Коли Wi-Fi підключено, а сайти не відкри: When Wi-Fi is connected but websites won't open: flushes the DNS cache and resets Winsock and TCP/IP. A restart is required.
strings.Коли оновлення зависли або постійно пада: When updates are stuck or keep failing: stops the services, creates a fresh update cache and starts the services again.
strings.Раз на тиждень Debora сам створить точку: Once a week Debora creates a restore point, runs the selected tasks, scans the PC and shows a notification with the results. It runs while you're signed in to Windows; a missed run happens at the next sign-in.
strings.Раз на тиждень Debora сама створить точк: Once a week Debora creates a restore point, runs the selected tasks, scans the PC and shows a notification with the results. It runs while you're signed in to Windows; a missed run happens at the next sign-in.
strings.Очищення диска (тимчасові файли, кеш оно: Disk cleanup (temporary files, update cache, installer leftovers)
strings.Новіші драйвери з каталогу Microsoft (ли: Newer drivers from the Microsoft catalog (recommended only)
strings.Оновлення Windows (зазвичай Windows став: Windows updates (Windows usually installs them itself)
strings.Чиста Windows без зайвих запитань і з ус: A clean Windows with no unnecessary questions and all drivers. Create a regular Windows USB drive (Microsoft's Media Creation Tool or Rufus), plug it in and click “Prepare USB drive”. During setup you only choose the disk; after the first sign-in Debora applies the settings and installs drivers from the internet.

During setup you only choose the disk; after the first sign-in Debora applies the settings and installs drivers from the internet.
strings.Додати драйвери цього ПК — Windows поста: Add this PC's drivers — Windows installs them during setup
strings.Дозволити Windows 11 на старому ПК (без: Allow Windows 11 on an older PC (no TPM 2.0 or Secure Boot, unsupported CPU)
strings.Після першого входу: рекомендовані налаш: After the first sign-in: Debora's recommended settings and drivers from the internet
strings.Усі сторонні драйвери в одну папку. Післ: All third-party drivers in one folder. After reinstalling, install them on the Drivers tab → “Drivers from a folder”.
strings.Один zip з відомостями про систему, драй: One zip with system info, drivers, errors and the change history — for troubleshooting
Each time changes are applied is a separate session. Undo restores exactly what was there before; values that you or Windows changed afterwards are not overwritten.
